name: Tsukamoto Shio
source:
Hobbies: Contributing to the radio. 
Likes: Radio programs, [url=/c91511]Kanata[/url] (radio DJ), the old [url=/c13501]Ririsu[/url].
Dislikes: The new Ririsu.

The main male character of the game and the one whom the player controls. He's the landlord of his own apartment building, making him the richest protagonist in the Memories Off series. Shio also works in the student council, thanks to Ririsu. He enjoys listening to radio, especially a radio show called T-Wave. 

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Memories_Off_6:_T-wave]Wikipedia[/url].]
